dispatch_conditions: Root must commit the exact frozen source, registration and this review, then bind pre-execution-commit.json before dispatch.
Exactly one real synthetic target may be started. Any failure stops this stage without a second target or a model substitute.

Acceptance requires the real marker, zero target exit, parent/target storage receipts, completed Linux whole-session cleanup, joined capture reader, reaped transport, immutable old evidence and all registered bounds.
Unknown cleanup is failure evidence, not evidence that owned processes ended. A live non-daemon reader may keep the entry alive and does not authorize restart.
Time after the 30-second process deadline is failed-run recovery time only and cannot produce a pass.

resolved_finding.issue: Outer wait or reader-join failure could replace the primary exception and skip its failure receipt.
resolved_finding.regressions: Two model-free failure-injection cases inspect helper status and the real entry failure receipt with a fake child. No actual target is spawned by these cases.
resolved_finding.resolution: finish_capture returns separate cancellation, transport, reader and Linux receipt states; run attempts the failure receipt before rethrowing the primary error. Unknown cleanup and time beyond 30 seconds cannot pass.

scope: Versioned receipt/real spawn boundary, fixed synthetic target, captured WSL entry and its bounded failure reporting; no broad repository audit.

test_evidence.note: Reviewed focused test source and root result record; did not repeat previously passed checks.
